body:
﻿## Reproduced missing player flow

Production `productionRenderMode` reads `?renderer=oblique` / `?view=oblique` before Phaser boots. The running HUD has zoom and angled pose controls, but no control that selects the renderer. Entering a URL reloads the page and is not a live view switch preserving an unsaved prison.

Related owner goal: #1592. Fresh searches for renderer/oblique/view switch found no narrower existing issue.

## Required delivery

- Discoverable HUD top-down / angled selection, current default unchanged.
- One existing worker/session/feed and unsaved prison across both directions.
- Lazy catalogue preparation before withdrawing the active scene.
- Stop/remove old scene to clean global input handlers; fresh-scene rollback on activation failure using verified cached catalogues.
- Current camera controls, minimap and a single room-plan ghost bridge route to the new scene.
- Logical centre preserved; in-memory camera pose/zoom round trips without new save fields.
- Real Full HD production build, unchanged worker identity and unsaved construction, both transitions and failed catalogue recovery.

Draft architecture and dormant/first wiring checkpoints:
https://github.com/woogitsu/lockstate/blob/codex/live-renderer-selection-20261002/docs/design/2026-10-02-live-renderer-selection/README.md

Runtime acceptance remains pending; controller unit proof does not establish actual worker continuity.

comments.body:
﻿Actual production-artifact acceptance is complete for the live view selector: 3/3 cases passed with one worker and original budgets. The existing unsaved Yard, worker identity, actual snapshot, command list and URL survive top-down → angled → top-down. Exact centre tile is retained, canvas changes and camera actions follow active mode. Registry 503 retains the world and allows retry; partial activation rollback clears owned handlers. Production mutation moving cleanup after attachments failed (11→13 actual handlers), restored acceptance passed 3/3.

Source: a718502d41. Proof and inspected Full HD image: https://github.com/woogitsu/lockstate/blob/codex/live-renderer-selection-20261002/docs/design/2026-10-02-live-renderer-selection/README.md

This is integrated-feature-branch evidence; production default remains unchanged. Main landing still belongs to the repository CI/merge gates.

title: Expose live top-down / angled view selection without resetting an unsaved prison
